descriptionByLocale.it: Responsabile circolazione treni ingresso laterale (formazione part-time) 60% | FFS - - - - - - Muovete la Svizzera con noi. Responsabile del traffico ferroviario con ingresso laterale (formazione a tempo parziale) Aeroporto di Zurigo, 1 settembre 2026, 60% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Puoi aspettarti 14 mesi di formazione part-time retribuita per diventare responsabile del traffico ferroviario. Dopo aver superato con successo l'esame finale, contribuirai attivamente dalla centrale operativa dell'aeroporto di Zurigo a garantire che ogni giorno 9.000 treni passeggeri e 2.000 treni merci arrivino a destinazione in tempo e in sicurezza. Il tuo equilibrio tra lavoro e vita privata è importante per noi durante la tua formazione. Ecco perché puoi scegliere liberamente i tuoi giorni pratici per il periodo di formazione con un carico di lavoro del 60% e pianificare con largo anticipo i giorni rimanenti per il tuo equilibrio di vita. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Per il lavoro notturno e nel fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, per il lavoro domenicale ad esempio 16 franchi l'ora. Se lavori di notte riceverai anche un'indennità dal 10 al 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di responsabile del traffico ferroviario, svolgi un ruolo importante nel buon funzionamento del traffico ferroviario e hai una grande influenza sulla soddisfazione dei clienti. - Tieni traccia della rete di collegamenti che ti è stata assegnata e gestisci i treni che la percorrono in modo ecologico. - Comunicherai con i compagni di squadra, i macchinisti e i centri di controllo e sarai responsabile di fornire informazioni ai nostri clienti nelle stazioni ferroviarie. - Se si verifica un'interruzione, reagire in modo sicuro e rapido per ripristinare il normale funzionamento. - Nel tuo lavoro quotidiano utilizzi un'ampia varietà di sistemi. Di conseguenza, il tuo lavoro si basa sulla fiducia nell’interazione tra persone e tecnologia. Scopri di più sul profilo professionale al prossimo evento informativo sulla carriera. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Per questo lavoro impegnativo, sei coscienzioso, affidabile, un giocatore di squadra e disposto a lavorare su turni di 24 ore. - Il tuo pensiero in rete e il tuo modo di lavorare indipendente ti aiutano a reagire rapidamente e correttamente alle interruzioni. - Aver completato un tirocinio professionale di 3 anni o un diploma di scuola superiore. - Parli fluentemente la lingua del luogo di formazione, sia verbalmente che per iscritto (livello C2) e possibilmente conosci una seconda lingua nazionale (livello A1). - Hai un perfetto senso del colore (nessuna debolezza nel rosso/verde). - Durante la procedura di richiesta vi chiederemo di fornire un estratto aggiornato del vostro registro penale e delle esecuzioni (non più vecchio di 3 mesi). Puoi ordinare i documenti quando ci inviti a incontrarti di persona. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. La classificazione durante il secondo allenamento si basa sulla funzione e sull'età. Puoi scoprire di più sullo stipendio specifico per questo ruolo nella voce laterale. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Il fatto che tu voglia spostare la Svizzera con noi è la nostra più grande motivazione. Ecco perché a questo punto non includiamo una lettera di motivazione. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. Questo inizia con la tua domanda. ## Ecco come continua. × Riceverai un feedback iniziale da parte nostra entro e non oltre 10 giorni lavorativi dal ricevimento della domanda. Inoltre, come datore di lavoro, siamo flessibili anche quando si tratta di conciliare la vostra vita professionale con la vostra vita privata. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry train traffic manager (part-time training) 60% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train traffic manager (part-time training) Zurich Airport, September 1st, 2026, 60% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. You can expect 14 months of paid part-time training to become a train traffic manager. After successfully completing your final exam, you will actively contribute from the operations center at Zurich Airport to ensuring that 9,000 passenger and 2,000 freight trains reach their destination on time and safely every day. Your work-life balance is important to us during your training. That's why you can freely choose your practical days for the training period with a 60% workload and plan the remaining days well in advance for your life balance. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - for example, 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. If you work at night, you will also receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can move that. - As a train traffic manager, you play an important role in the smooth running of rail traffic and have a major influence on customer satisfaction. - You keep track of the route network assigned to you and manage the trains running on it ecologically. - You will communicate with teammates, train drivers and control centers and be responsible for providing information to our customers at train stations. - If a disruption occurs, you react safety-oriented and quickly to restore normal operation. - In your daily work you use a wide variety of systems. Accordingly, your work is based on trust in the interaction between people and technology. Find out more about the career profile at the next career information event. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work 24-hour shifts. - Your networked thinking and your independent way of working help you to react quickly and correctly to disruptions. - You have completed a 3-year vocational apprenticeship or high school diploma. - You are fluent in the language of the training location, both verbally and in writing (level C2) and ideally have knowledge of a second national language (level A1). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness). - During the application process, we will require you to provide a current extract from your criminal and debt collection register (not older than 3 months). You can order the documents when you invite us to meet you in person. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision Application Final decision Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 101533 Team leader East operations center Telephone +41 79 734 59 07 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Find out more Find out more

Responsable du trafic ferroviaire à entrée latérale (formation à temps partiel) Aéroport de Zurich, 1er septembre 2026, 60% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela avec impatience. Vous pouvez vous attendre à 14 mois de formation rémunérée à temps partiel pour devenir gestionnaire du trafic ferroviaire. Après avoir réussi votre examen final, vous contribuerez activement, depuis le centre opérationnel de l'aéroport de Zurich, à ce que 9 000 trains de passagers et 2 000 trains de marchandises atteignent chaque jour leur destination à temps et en toute sécurité. Votre équilibre travail-vie personnelle est important pour nous pendant votre formation. C'est pourquoi vous pouvez choisir librement vos journées pratiques pour le stage avec une charge de travail de 60% et planifier les jours restants bien à l'avance pour votre équilibre de vie. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. Nous payons un supplément de salaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end - par exemple 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Si vous travaillez de nuit, vous bénéficierez également d'une indemnité horaire de 10 à 30 %. Cela signifie que vous disposez de plus de temps libre que les employés qui ne travaillent pas de nuit ni de week-end. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que gestionnaire du trafic ferroviaire, vous jouez un rôle important dans le bon déroulement du trafic ferroviaire et avez une influence majeure sur la satisfaction des clients. - Vous suivez le réseau de lignes qui vous est attribué et gérez écologiquement les trains qui y circulent. - Vous communiquerez avec vos coéquipiers, les conducteurs de train et les centres de contrôle et serez responsable de fournir des informations à nos clients dans les gares. - En cas de perturbation, vous réagissez de manière sûre et rapide pour rétablir un fonctionnement normal. - Dans votre travail quotidien, vous utilisez une grande variété de systèmes. Par conséquent, votre travail est basé sur la confiance dans l’interaction entre les personnes et la technologie. Apprenez-en davantage sur le profil de carrière lors du prochain événement d’information sur les carrières. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Pour ce travail exigeant, vous êtes consciencieux, fiable, avez l'esprit d'équipe et êtes prêt à travailler par quarts de 24 heures. - Votre réflexion en réseau et votre manière de travailler indépendante vous aident à réagir rapidement et correctement aux perturbations. - Vous êtes titulaire d'un apprentissage professionnel de 3 ans ou d'un diplôme d'études secondaires. - Vous maîtrisez couramment la langue du lieu de formation, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit (niveau C2) et possédez idéalement la connaissance d'une deuxième langue nationale (niveau A1). - Vous avez un sens parfait de la couleur (pas de faiblesse rouge/vert). - Lors du processus de candidature, nous vous demanderons de fournir un extrait à jour de votre casier judiciaire et des poursuites (datant de moins de 3 mois). Vous pouvez commander les documents lorsque vous nous invitez à vous rencontrer en personne. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry as train traffic manager: in 2026 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train traffic manager: in 2026 Zurich Airport or Limmattal marshalling yard, by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. You will complete paid training to become a train traffic manager, which lasts eight months and is carried out in Zurich. After successfully completing your final exam, you will work in the Zurich Airport operations center / Limmattal marshalling yard and help ensure that 9,000 passenger and 2,000 freight trains reach their destination on time and safely every day. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - for example, 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. If you work at night, you will also receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. Possible start date: - October 1st, 2026 You can make a difference. - As a train traffic manager, you play an important role in the smooth running of rail traffic and have a major influence on customer satisfaction. - You keep track of the route network assigned to you and manage the trains running on it ecologically. - You will communicate with teammates, train drivers and control centers and be responsible for providing information to our customers at train stations. - If a disruption occurs, you react safety-oriented and quickly to restore normal operation. - In your daily work you use a wide variety of systems. Accordingly, your work is based on trust in the interaction between people and technology. Find out more about the career profile at our next career information event. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work 24-hour shifts. - Your networked thinking and your independent way of working help you to react quickly and correctly to disruptions. - You have completed a 3-year vocational apprenticeship or high school diploma. - You are fluent in the language of the training location, both verbally and in writing (level C2). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness). - During the application process, we will require you to provide a current extract from your criminal record and debt collection register (not older than 3 months). The document can be ordered when you are invited to get to know each other in person. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision Up to two months after receipt of application Application Final decision Up to two months after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 99968 Team leading operations center East Telephone +41 79 734 59 07 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Lateral entry train driver: in shunting Zurich, by arrangement, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. Around 14,000 passenger transport employees ensure that the more than 1.4 million SBB customers we transport every day have easy access to public transport and travel from A to B both safely and on time. As a central professional group, the shunting personnel make a key contribution to this. An innovative working environment awaits you, in which you will move SBB together with your teammates, as well as varied and paid training. You also have various internal training opportunities. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you will receive additional time surcharges of between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. Possible training starts in 2026/2027: - June 1st, 2026 - August 1st, 2026 - October 1st, 2026 - January 1st, 2027 - March 1st, 2027 - May 1st, 2027 - June 1st, 2027 - August 1st, 2027 - October 1st, 2027 You can you move. - You prepare passenger trains for their journey and move them to the correct starting point in and around the station (up to a maximum of 40 km/h). - You put trains together, separate individual cars and make sure that everything is in the right place. - You get the train ready to go, check the most important functions and carry out brake checks. - During your work, you maintain an overview and ensure that all processes run safely and smoothly. - You can repair minor problems yourself or report them to the responsible office. You can find out more about the job profile here. This is what you bring with you. - You are attentive, concentrated and physically resilient in order to successfully complete this demanding work in 24-hour shifts. You also enjoy working outside in any weather. - Since all instructions and documentation are electronic, you will quickly find your way around using digital tools. - You have completed basic education (at least EBA) and already have practical experience - ideally from a craft or logistics environment. - You have very good spoken and written knowledge of German (level B2). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness) ## Your salary and benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. Shunting Specialist Ai40 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Shunting Specialist Ai40 Interlaken, immediately or by arrangement, 60-100% Apply now What you can look forward to. Around 14,000 passenger transport employees ensure that the more than 1.3 million customers SBB transports daily have easy access to public transport and travel safely and punctually from A to B. As a central professional group, shunting personnel make a key contribution to this. An innovative working environment awaits you, where you will move SBB together with your team colleagues. In addition, you have various internal further training opportunities, such as training to become a shunting locomotive driver. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. Night and weekend work is additionally remunerated - e.g., with 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts, you also receive time supplements between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. What you can move. - As a shunting specialist, you contribute to our customers traveling reliably and punctually by moving, forming, and dismantling passenger trains according to the train formation plan. - You lead individual shunting movements and return train compositions. - Your responsibility for train preparation includes preheating and air-conditioning the trains as well as performing train inspections and brake tests. - You report irregularities, special incidents, or deviations to the responsible office. - Due to your safety awareness, it is a matter of course for you to work according to regulations. Find out more about the job profile here. 
• What you bring with you. - You are already a trained shunting specialist Ai40. - You are attentive, focused, and physically resilient to successfully cope with this demanding work in 24-hour shift operation. Furthermore, you enjoy working outside in any weather. - Since all instructions and documentation are electronic, you will quickly find your way around with digital tools. - You are fluent in German (level C2). - You have perfect color vision (no red-green deficiency). Your salary and benefits. We have a fair and progressive salary system and actively advocate for equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information on the salary system at SBB is transparently viewable. This position is in requirement level D, regional allowance level 0. More about salary and benefits. How to get started. That you want to move Switzerland with us is the greatest motivation for us. That is why we do not require a cover letter for this position. If you still want to share your motivation with us, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier on a first-name basis. This starts with your application. What happens next. × At the latest 10 working days after receipt of your application, you will receive initial feedback from us. We do not accept dossiers from recruitment agencies for this position. 
• What we offer. Benefits Benefits Learn more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. Furthermore, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Learn more Learn more Differences welcome Differences welcome Learn more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Learn more Learn more Career and development Career and development Learn more We support our employees according to their personal needs and ambitions. For this, we provide a wide range of interdisciplinary and specialist further training offers. We contribute financially and in terms of time to selected external further training. Learn more

descriptionByLocale.en: Shunting specialist: in Ai40 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Shunting specialist: in Ai40 Zurich, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. Around 14,000 passenger transport employees ensure that the more than 1.3 million SBB customers we transport every day have easy access to public transport and travel from A to B both safely and on time. As a central professional group, the shunting personnel make a key contribution to this. An innovative working environment awaits you, in which you will move SBB together with your teammates, as well as varied and paid training. You also have various internal training opportunities, such as training to become a shunting engine driver. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you will receive additional time surcharges of between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can move that. - As a shunting specialist, you will help ensure that our customers travel reliably and on time by moving, forming and dismantling passenger trains according to the train formation plan. - You lead individual shunting movements and reset train compositions. - Your responsibility for train preparation includes preheating and air conditioning the trains as well as carrying out train inspections and brake tests. - You report any irregularities, special incidents or deviations to the responsible authority. - Due to your safety awareness, it is natural for you to work according to regulations. You can find out more about the job profile here. This is what you bring with you. - You are attentive, concentrated and physically resilient in order to successfully complete this demanding work in 24-hour shifts. You also enjoy working outside in any weather. - You are already a trained shunting specialist in Ai40. - Since all instructions and documentation are electronic, you will quickly find your way around using digital tools. - You are fluent in German (level C2). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red-green weakness). ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level D, regional allowance level 2. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Auf dich wartet eine abwechslungsreiche, bezahlte 9-monatige Vollzeitausbildung. Die theoretische Ausbildung absolvierst du in Olten und deine ersten Praxiserfahrungen sammelst du in einem regional zugeteilten Rangierbahnhof.
Du siehst unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten und Schichtarbeit als Vorteil, um deine Freizeit zu geniessen, während andere arbeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet, z.B. mit einem Stundenlohnzusatz von 16 Franken für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du Zeitzuschläge von 10 bis 30%, was dir mehr Freizeit ermöglicht.
Benefits wie kostenloses GA, vergünstigtes Reisen im Ausland - auch für die Familie - findest du auf unserer Website unter Benefits und mehr Infos zum Beruf findest du hier.
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Lokführerin oder Lokführer Bauzüge leistest du einen grossen Beitrag, um die Erneuerungen der Trassen (Gleise, Schotter usw.) sicherzustellen.
- Du leistest und führst verschiedene und komplexe Rangierbewegungen von Zügen bis zu maximal 100 km/h selbständig, formierst und zerlegst diese und bereitest sie für die Fahrt vor.
- Um die regionale Logistik sicherzustellen, entwirfst, beantragst und bestellst du Fahrordnungen termingerecht und verantwortest die Versorgung von Baustellen mit den erforderlichen Materialien.
- Du hast eine hohe Verantwortung in der Betriebssicherheit der Bauzüge. Das Prüfen der Arbeitsstellensicherheit sowie Erstellen von Rapporten runden die Tätigkeiten ab.
- Zusätzlich wirst du als Lokführerinnen und Lokführer Bauzüge auf der Baustelle eingesetzt und dein handwerkliches Geschick wird gefordert.
Das bringst du mit.
- Für diese anspruchsvolle Arbeit bist du gewissenhaft, zuverlässig, teamfähig und bereit im 24 Stunden Schichtbetrieb zu arbeiten.
- Du bist körperlich und psychisch belastbar und kannst mit deiner eigenverantwortlichen Arbeitsweise bewusst und richtig agieren.
- Du hast eine mindestens zweijährige anerkannte Berufslehre inkl. Fähigkeitsausweis, idealerweise in der Baubranche und mit Erfahrungen im Gleisbau oder abgeschlossene Matura.
- Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse (Niveau C1) in Wort und Schrift sind Voraussetzung.
- Du besitzt den Führerausweis Kategorie B.
- Du verfügst über einen einwandfreien Farbsinn (keine Rot- / Grünschwäche) und weist keine Einträge im Straf- und Betreibungsregister auf.

Macchinista con ingresso laterale: nel treno cantiere con esperienza manuale a Winterthur, da subito o su appuntamento, 100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Ti aspetta un programma di formazione a tempo pieno di 9 mesi vario e retribuito. Completerai la tua formazione teorica a Olten e acquisirai la tua prima esperienza pratica in uno scalo di smistamento assegnato a livello regionale. Consideri l'orario di lavoro irregolare e il lavoro a turni come un vantaggio per goderti il ​​tempo libero mentre gli altri lavorano. Per il lavoro notturno e fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, ad esempio per il lavoro domenicale una paga oraria supplementare di 16 franchi. Puoi trovare vantaggi come AG gratuita, viaggi scontati all'estero - anche per la famiglia - sul nostro sito web alla voce Benefit e maggiori informazioni sul lavoro qui. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di macchinista di treni da cantiere, dai un grande contributo al rinnovamento dei percorsi (binari, ghiaia, ecc.). - Effettui ed effettui autonomamente vari e complessi movimenti di manovra di treni fino ad un massimo di 100 km/h, li allestisci, smonti e li prepari per il viaggio. - Per garantire la logistica regionale, redigete, richiedete e ordinate gli ordini di guida in tempo e siete responsabili della fornitura dei cantieri con i materiali necessari. - Hai un'elevata responsabilità per la sicurezza operativa dei treni da cantiere. Il controllo della sicurezza sul lavoro e la redazione di reportistica completano l'attività. - Inoltre, sarai impiegato come macchinista per i treni edili in cantiere e saranno richieste le tue competenze tecniche. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Per questo lavoro impegnativo, sei coscienzioso, affidabile, un giocatore di squadra e disposto a lavorare su turni di 24 ore. - Sei fisicamente e mentalmente resistente e puoi agire consapevolmente e correttamente con il tuo modo di lavorare indipendente. - Possiedi almeno due anni di formazione professionale riconosciuta comprensiva di un certificato di idoneità, preferibilmente nel settore edile e con esperienza nella costruzione di binari oppure hai completato il diploma di scuola superiore. - Prerequisito è la conoscenza della lingua tedesca scritta e parlata (livello C1). - Possiedi la patente di guida di categoria B. - Hai un perfetto senso dei colori (nessun punto debole del rosso/verde) e non sei iscritto nel registro penale o nelle esecuzioni. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience Winterthur, from now on or by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. A varied, paid 9-month full-time training program awaits you. You will complete your theoretical training in Olten and gain your first practical experience in a regionally assigned marshalling yard. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits and you can find more information about the job here. You can move that. - As a train driver for construction trains, you make a big contribution to ensuring the renewal of the routes (tracks, gravel, etc.). - You carry out and carry out various and complex shunting movements of trains up to a maximum of 100 km/h independently, form and dismantle them and prepare them for the journey. - In order to ensure regional logistics, you draft, apply for and order driving orders on time and are responsible for supplying construction sites with the necessary materials. - You have a high level of responsibility for the operational safety of the construction trains. Checking workplace safety and creating reports round off the activities. - In addition, you will be deployed as a train driver for construction trains on the construction site and your technical skills will be required. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work in 24-hour shifts. - You are physically and mentally resilient and can act consciously and correctly with your independent way of working. - You have at least two years of recognized vocational training including a certificate of skills, ideally in the construction industry and with experience in track construction or have completed your high school diploma. - Fluent written and spoken German (level C1) is a prerequisite. - You have a category B driving license. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. descriptionByLocale.fr: Contremaître ou contremaître en construction de voies 60-100% | CFF - - - - - - Déménagez en Suisse avec nous. Chef de chantier ou contremaître à Bâle (BS/BL), immédiatement ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela avec impatience. Chez nous, vous dirigerez de manière indépendante une équipe de construction de voies, coordonnerez les processus sur le chantier et veillerez au respect des délais, de la qualité et de la sécurité. Vous êtes au cœur de l'action, vous travaillez avec des machines modernes et vous vous impliquez lorsque cela compte le plus. Attendez-vous à des projets variés, une équipe solide et une vraie solidarité. Grâce à vous et à vos collaborateurs, les CFF peuvent transporter chaque jour plus d'un million de personnes d'un point A à un point B. Nous recherchons des renforts pour le périmètre suivant : Muttenz. Nous soutenons vos souhaits de développement ultérieur et proposons de nombreuses possibilités de formation interne pour votre carrière personnelle aux CFF. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, par exemple une AG de 2e classe gratuite et des voyages à l'étranger à prix réduit - également pour la famille. Vous pouvez trouver des informations plus intéressantes sur nos avantages sur notre site Web. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que contremaître ou contremaître, vous réalisez et gérez des travaux d'entretien ou de rénovation ainsi que des travaux de superstructure et de génie civil dans le domaine routier. - Vous assurez la gestion technique des travaux et assurez un traitement optimal sur site ; soit pour l'ensemble du chantier, soit limité à un tronçon de voie (pour les grands chantiers). - Vous dirigerez les travaux sur plusieurs lieux de travail et prendrez en charge la gestion technique des chefs de chantier et des salariés. - Vous apportez un soutien à la préparation des travaux et au reporting. - En tant que responsable de la sécurité, vous prenez les mesures de sécurité et vérifiez leur conformité conformément à la politique de sécurité. - Vous gérez le service d'astreinte et intervenez sur site en cas d'incidents particuliers. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Pour ce rôle, vous disposez d'un apprentissage dans le secteur de la construction (par exemple constructeur de voies de circulation ou maçon) et d'une expérience dans le secteur routier. - Idéalement, vous avez déjà suivi une formation continue de contremaître (POS ou SBV) ou une formation de contremaître SBV (VOS). - En tant que manager, vous vous caractérisez par votre bonne communication et votre capacité à travailler en équipe. - Vous êtes prêt à travailler selon des horaires irréguliers et à travailler à l'extérieur. - Vous disposez d'un permis de conduire de catégorie B., un permis de conduire valide de catégorie E (remorque) est un avantage. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Ce poste est au niveau d'exigence H, niveau d'allocation régionale 1. En savoir plus sur les salaires et les avantages sociaux. ## Cela vous permet de démarrer. Le fait que vous souhaitiez déménager en Suisse avec nous est notre plus grande motivation. C'est pourquoi nous n'incluons pas de lettre de motivation à ce stade. Si vous souhaitez tout de même nous faire part de votre motivation, vous avez toujours la possibilité de le faire dans notre outil de candidature. Faire de grandes choses est plus facile si vous le faites vous-même. Cela commence par votre candidature. ## C'est comme ça que ça continue. × Vous recevrez un premier retour de notre part au plus tard 10 jours ouvrables après réception de votre candidature. De plus, en tant qu'employeur, nous sommes également flexibles lorsqu'il s'agit de concilier votre vie professionnelle avec votre vie privée. descriptionByLocale.fr: Contremaître ou contremaître en construction de voies 60-100% | CFF - - - - - - Déménagez en Suisse avec nous. Contremaître de construction de voies ou contremaître Bern Mittelland (BE/SO/AG), immédiatement ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. Chez nous, vous dirigerez de manière indépendante une équipe de construction de voies, coordonnerez les processus sur le chantier et veillerez au respect des délais, de la qualité et de la sécurité. Vous êtes au cœur de l'action, vous travaillez avec des machines modernes et vous vous impliquez lorsque cela compte le plus. Attendez-vous à des projets variés, une équipe solide et une vraie solidarité. Grâce à vous et à vos collaborateurs, les CFF peuvent transporter chaque jour plus d'un million de personnes d'un point A à un point B. Nous recherchons des renforts pour le périmètre suivant : Lenzburg, Olten et Ostermundigen. Nous soutenons vos souhaits de développement ultérieur et proposons de nombreuses possibilités de formation interne pour votre carrière personnelle aux CFF. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, par exemple une AG de 2e classe gratuite et des voyages à l'étranger à prix réduit - également pour la famille. Vous pouvez trouver des informations plus intéressantes sur nos avantages sur notre site Web. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que contremaître ou contremaître, vous réalisez et gérez des travaux d'entretien ou de rénovation ainsi que des travaux de superstructure et de génie civil dans le domaine routier. - Vous assurez la gestion technique des travaux et assurez un traitement optimal sur site ; soit pour l'ensemble du chantier, soit limité à un tronçon de voie (pour les grands chantiers). - Vous dirigerez les travaux sur plusieurs lieux de travail et prendrez en charge la gestion technique des chefs de chantier et des salariés. - Vous apportez un soutien à la préparation des travaux et au reporting. - En tant que responsable de la sécurité, vous prenez les mesures de sécurité et vérifiez leur conformité conformément à la politique de sécurité. - Vous gérez le service d'astreinte et intervenez sur site en cas d'incidents particuliers. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Pour ce rôle, vous disposez d'un apprentissage dans le secteur de la construction (par exemple constructeur de voies de circulation ou maçon) et d'une expérience dans le secteur routier. - Idéalement, vous avez déjà suivi une formation continue de contremaître (POS ou SBV) ou une formation de contremaître SBV (VOS). - En tant que manager, vous vous caractérisez par votre bonne communication et votre capacité à travailler en équipe. - Vous êtes prêt à travailler selon des horaires irréguliers et à travailler à l'extérieur. - Vous disposez d'un permis de conduire de catégorie B., un permis de conduire valide de catégorie E (remorque) est un avantage. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Ce poste est au niveau d'exigence G, niveau d'allocation régionale 1. En savoir plus sur les salaires et les avantages sociaux. ## Cela vous permet de démarrer. Le fait que vous souhaitiez déménager en Suisse avec nous est notre plus grande motivation. C'est pourquoi nous n'incluons pas de lettre de motivation à ce stade. Si vous souhaitez tout de même nous faire part de votre motivation, vous avez toujours la possibilité de le faire dans notre outil de candidature. Faire de grandes choses est plus facile si vous le faites vous-même. Cela commence par votre candidature. ## C'est comme ça que ça continue. × Vous recevrez un premier retour de notre part au plus tard 10 jours ouvrables après réception de votre candidature. Nous n'acceptons pas les dossiers des recruteurs pour ce poste. ## C'est ce que nous proposons.
